headline: Yield Breaks 7.74%, Government Absorbs Rp10 T from Sukuk Auction Results
summary: Indonesia's government absorbed Rp10 trillion at an eight-series sukuk auction, with the yield reaching 7.74%. Incoming bids totalled Rp20.10 trillion.
why: Sukuk are Islamic-law-compliant government bonds, and auction yields show the borrowing cost of Indonesia's government debt.
original_headline: Imbal Hasil Tembus 7,74%, Pemerintah Serap Rp10 T Hasil Lelang Sukuk
